entities.name: Claria
entities.description: Lady and cartographer of Sumifa, descendant of Samor the Collector.

entities.name: Sumifa
entities.description: Land where Claria was a lady and cartographer.

entities.name: Maceo
entities.description: Prince of Sumifa who broke off his betrothal to Claria.

entities.name: Thedeso
entities.description: Maceo's father, who died in 3050 AR.

entities.name: Kalkuk
entities.description: Claria's uncle whose map shop she inherited.

entities.name: Cheyne
entities.description: Traveler who rescued Claria and developed feelings for her.

entities.name: Ogwater Rifkin
entities.description: Traveler who banished the Beast of the Hours.

entities.name: The Chimes
entities.description: Destination Claria traveled to with Cheyne and Ogwater.

entities.name: Riolla Hifrata
entities.description: Commander of assassins who captured Claria.

entities.name: Beast of the Hours
entities.description: Creature released and banished using Claria's name song.

events.summary: Maceo breaks off his betrothal to Claria and casts her out after his father Thedeso dies.
events.quote: Maceo broke off the betrothal and cast her out

events.summary: Cheyne and Ogwater Rifkin meet Claria while looking for a map to the Chimes, and she joins them.
events.quote: she joined them in traveling there

events.summary: Riolla Hifrata's assassins capture Claria and bind her to a crystal spire of the Chimes, but Cheyne rescues her.
Ogwater banishes the Beast of the Hours; Claria and Cheyne realize they have feelings for one another.
events.quote: Claria and Cheyne realized they had developed feelings for one another

relations.note: They realized they had feelings for each other.
relations.quote: Claria and Cheyne realized they had developed feelings for one another
